name: intuitivo.pt
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: intuitivo.pt scores 74 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 141 elements on /, /institutions, /plans, for example .hero-flow__step--done > .hero-flow__extra[data-v-56894745=""] > small and .hero-flow__step--playing > .hero-flow__extra[data-v-56894745=""] > small. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 37 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /institutions, /plans, for example .project-link. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: 10 images are not served as WebP or AVIF
fix.evidence: rui_feliciano_9bf2962f4f.jpg on / (JPEG, 1587 KB), sofia_damiana_4fc8a1dfe9.jpg on / (JPEG, 614 KB), patricia_pinho_40a9c9a424.jpg on / (JPEG, 467 KB), IMG_20250708_192240_EDIT_033f7d86ca.jpg on /plans (JPEG, 467 KB) and 6 more. WebP is about 30% smaller at…
fix.fix: Serve WebP or AVIF through the CDN or image service, or with <picture> and a JPEG or PNG fallback.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Nothing on the page blocks the back/forward cache
Every page has a meta description
